10287.overview: His name is Zool, and he is a gremlin-like creature from another dimension. He is forced to land on the Earth, but his sole goal is to attain the prestigious ranking of a Ninja. To do that, Zool will have to travel through six worlds, each divided into three stages, defeat his enemies, and prove himself worthy of that title.

24641.overview:
Like its predecessor X-Out, Z-Out is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up. A horde of largely-organic enemies threaten the safety of your planet, and they must be destroyed over the course of six levels.There are power-ups available, but the game is less centered around these than some are. 

Whilst some shoot 'em ups are much easier with a second player, Z-Out takes design steps to legislate against this. In a 2-player game, most power-ups are unavailable, and even those which are only come into effect on level 3. Another variation is that the 1-player mode uses restart points, but the 2-player mode does not, so as to keep both players in the same place.

29567.overview: The intergalactic gremlin ninja Zool returns, and this time his enemies in the game were named Krool and his assistant Mental Block, whose goal is to stifle the world's imagination, causing rampant boredom. In his fight Zool is aided by his female companion, named Zooz (in a red costume), and his faithful dog Zoon. The ending contained a hint at a possible further sequel

90564.overview:
Zork: The Great Underground Empire is a classic text adventure game. The player begins as an "adventurer" standing near a white house in a nice forest, but soon descends into the Great Underground Empire, where most of the game takes place. The player's quest is to collect the Nineteen Treasures of Zork. 

As was typical for adventure games of its era, Zork does not use graphics. Instead, it communicates with the player via text, and the player interacts with the game by typing commands, such as "examine mailbox" or "take torch". For movement, the player types in geographical directions (such as "north" or "east" - or just "n" and "e"), and can check what items are being carried with the "inventory" command (or just "i"). 

The game was ported over from mainframes in the late 1970s, and is one of the first examples of its genre.

93566.overview: Zany Golf, also known as Will Harvey's Zany Golf, is a video game with a fantasy take on miniature golf, developed by Sandcastle Productions and published by Electronic Arts. The game was originally developed in 1988 for the Apple IIGS and became the first Apple IIGS game to attract the mainstream gaming market and be ported to other platforms. It was subsequently ported to the Amiga, Atari ST and DOS machines. In 1990 it was ported to a video game console, the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis.

93567.overview:
In Zombi you control a team of four intrepid travelers, who have landed their helicopter on the roof of a shopping centre in the hope of finding fuel. The problem is that, with Hell full, Zombies are walking the earth, devouring humans as they please.

Zombi is a point and click adventure game in which you control the four characters (Alexandre, Sylvie, Yannick and Patrick) in turn, taking each of them individually through the abandoned complex. Lots of potentially-useful items have been left behind, some stored in cupboards - work out what they could be used for. 

Try to find a weapon with which to attack the zombies - bare-hands fighting only works for a few attempts before your character is worn out. Dead zombies should be placed in the freezer in the basement to stop them re-emerging. You have free rein over the shopping mall, and can use the bed shops to rest and the food shops for nourishment. Be wary of the dark and zombie-filled basement though.

98582.overview:
Zak McKracken is a tabloid reporter (and not a very good one at that). After having a psychedelic dream one day, Zak realizes that something is wrong -- space aliens are dumbifying the general public through the telephone system. Zak must stop this, but he can't do it alone. After finding a strange crystal, Zak manages to get the help of the anthropologist Annie and her friends, Melissa and Leslie. The four unlikely heroes must now figure out a way to destroy the dumbifying devices and save the Earth.

Zak McKracken and the Alien Mindbenders is a third-person puzzle-solving adventure similar in gameplay to Maniac Mansion. The player chooses verb commands (Open, Pick Up, Give, etc.; there are no Look or Talk commands) to interact with the game world. The game features up to four controllable protagonists; it is possible to switch between them at any time after they have been introduced, and also exchange inventory items if the characters are in the same location. The game can be described as a "globe-trotting" adventure, since the heroes are required to travel to different exotic countries and even leave the Earth for a while in order to complete it. Some of the puzzles are optional or can be solved in different ways.

122259.overview: Zoom! is an arcade style puzzle game. Your character Zoomer (a Pacman lookalike with arms & legs) must trace the outline of the squares on the game board to light them up. Points are awarded when full squares are formed, although the game also displays how many lines must still be completed. You proceed to the next level when all the squares have been lit up.

123832.overview:
Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz is a text adventure, a sequel to the classic first Zork. Once again, the game is set in the Great Underground Empire, but this time the main goal is to face off against the titular Wizard. 

Like its predecessor, Zork II plays like any other text adventure: there are no graphics - only text - and the player types commands such as "lift cage" or "examine robot".

123833.overview:
In the third game of the adventure game series Zork, you are once again a nameless adventurer, only this time you won't travel through a beautiful magical land, but are immediately cast into a deep dungeon. Like in a dream, you hear a mysterious voice telling you that you have passed all the tests but one. When consciousness returns to you, you find yourself on the endless spiral of stairs, with only your trusty lantern near you... will you be able to survive the horrors of the Dungeon?

Like its predecessors, Zork III: The Dungeon Master is a text adventure game. You read descriptions of rooms and then interact with the game by typing commands. As all early Zork games, it is very easy to get stuck in the game, so you'll have to reload several times in order to find the correct way.

123834.overview:
Lord Dimwit Flathead the Excessive was so much in love with himself that he ordered to erect a huge statue of himself in the Fublio Valley. This angered a local resident named Megaboz the Magnificent, who cast a curse over Dimwit and the entire Empire, and disappeared. Ninety-four years later, the curse is still in effect, and the king Wurb Flathead is looking for a brave adventurer who would find a way to remove it. This adventurer, naturally, is the game's protagonist, who possesses a piece of parchment given to him by his ancestors, which might be the key to the whole mystery...

Zork Zero: The Revenge of Megaboz is chronologically a prequel to the first three Zork games, and is a text adventure with a graphical interface and scene-based colors and borders. Like its predecessors, the game relies on puzzle-solving, including inventory item manipulation as well as logic-based puzzles. An interactive map, in-game hint system, and the included Encyclopedia Frobozzica are there to make the player's task somewhat easier. The game also includes four graphical mini-games based on popular logic puzzles.

127058.overview: Binary Asylum's final release puts you in control of a helicopter and sets you 32 missions to complete. The level structures involve different military objectives of protecting or destroying a particular area. The surprise is in the graphics: patchwork-quilt style landscapes and a remote view reminiscent of Virus. The game offers joystick and mouse control options, as well as sections in which you must direct ships and planes. A range of weapons are offered with resupply ships on the water to dock with.

127059.overview: With a similar gameplay as the isometric Desert Strike, Zeewolf offers arcadesque helicopter combat in a 3D surrounding. Despite its mainly action-oriented gameplay, the 32 levels often involve support, transport and rescue missions - dropping or refueling friendly units in the combat zone, for example. In exchange, other units serve you as rearming points or help you fighting the enemy.

129293.overview: This horizontally-scrolling shoot 'em up features 16 levels and 450 screens of Nemesis-inspired action. You pilot a spacecraft through the levels, shooting as many of the encroaching meanies and mounted turrets as possible. Power-up tokens are offered for shooting some, which can be used to obtain better weapons including ground-attack lasers, speed ups and multiple bullets. Extra lives are on offer as well, which you'll certainly need, especially as you have to go back a long way when losing a life.

129316.overview: Ziriax is a side-scrolling futuristic "shoot-'em-up" set in a futuristic environment, similar to R-Type. The player controls a spaceship-like aircraft that is trying to survive amidst the fire of hostile ships and other enemies. There are five stages in the game altogether; each contains a fight against a boss enemy at the end. Small spheres are dropped by enemies; collecting these spheres bestows the player-controlled ship with various power-ups. These include two additional small ships above and below the main one, an ability to shoot backwards, and missiles that can be shot diagonally.

129320.overview:
Zarathrusta is a cave-flying game influenced by Thrust. Apparently, the resistance forces have captured a number of space ships, which could aid in the struggle against the empire. However, these ships need fuel, and that fuel is find in the form of "klystron pods", which must be recovered from a range of hostile environments. 

Your task is to fly your small spaceship above and below ground, capturing the pods. Your spaceship can rotate in 360 degrees, allowing for easy movements through the cave systems, if it wasn't for gravity pulling you down, and inertia, which means you could crash into walls or other objects if you don't turn around and thrust in the other direction. 

Each level is cleared by recovering the klystron pods, which are the same thing as the ball you pick up in Thrust. Pick up the pod with your tractor beam, and a towing line will be attached. Towing the ball means that you have another object altering your course, though; if you break quickly, the forces of inertia will make the ball travel forward, pulling you in its direction. At later levels, the pod becomes heavier, and must be pulled using a force field. Travelling too fast will make the ball slip out of the field, forcing you to pick it up again, possibly from a very dangerous area.

The levels are guarded by cannons, which can be shot down using either your conventional cannon or a laser cannon. Beware, though, for the laser eats up your fuel supplies very quickly. Refueling is possible by activating the tractor beam above the fuel pods stationed throughout the levels.

Whereas Thrust used vector graphics, the visuals of Zarathrusta consist of bitmaps.

130910.overview:
Zeppelins were the sky's biggest aircrafts ever. So - have you ever thought about managing a fleet of them? In Zeppelin this is just your job. Invest in new technologies, build airships for several nations, find new flight routes and win the race with competing companies.

You can participate in flying competitions, take on special missions (such as time critical assignments), speculate at the stock-market, etc. The game also contains precise historical material; political and economical developments strongly influence the storyline.

142779.overview:
At its most basic level, Zero Gravity can be thought of as a Pong game, as the player controls a bat which must be used to hit a ball as it comes towards you. The main twist is that the gameplay is completely 3-dimensional, with control over the horizontal and vertical positions of the bat. The game uses a split-screen view, with the top half viewed from the perspective of Player 1, and the bottom from that of Player 2, even when only one of them is human.

Each time you get the ball past your opponent's bat, a score is added to a tally, and a number of points are awarded. Along the side-wall of the playing arena there are 8 tokens to be hit, awarding extra points, speeding the game up, deducting points from your opponent, and so on.

151350.overview:
Colored blocks raining down on a playfield, we’ve seen that before. Zyconix takes the Columns principle (align three or more bricks of the same color to make them disappear) and adds a few twists of its own:

First, there are no groups or columns of stones, only single blocks.
Second, several of them slide down at once, and you select and move them with a cursor.
Third, only horizontal and diagonal lines disappear, but not stacks of the same color.
Add a few special objects from bombs to drills to a breakout ball that you can actually deflect grabbing a brick as a paddle, mix with four play modes (normal, pre-filled playfield and two time trial variants), and the result is a fast-pasted, tricky test of agility. 
Two players can compete in split-screen mode, where each removed line turns the corresponding number of bricks on the opponent’s field into indestructible obstacle blocks. Soloists adjust the difficulty level by tweaking the number of blocks in a line (from three to six), number of colors and frequency of new stones appearing.

151355.overview: Zombie Apocalypse is a mouse controlled shoot-em-up where the goal is to kill as many zombies possible before you run out of energy. In every level you have to kill a certain number of zombies to be victorious. Some zombies that appears will throw hand grenades at you. Left mouse button is for normal fire and the right one is for throwing grenades. Ammo is limited but boxes with extra ammo will drop from the sky now and then (red boxes for bullets and green ones for grenades).

151356.overview:
The Zaxxon defence system must be destroyed in this isometric-viewed shoot 'em up. The game has three stages, first taking you through Asteroid City, which is heavily protected by aircraft, guns and missiles. Many barriers are alarmed, leaving you with limited space to progress through, and fire must constantly be dodged.

Stage two is a space shoot out against hordes of enemy aircraft - those you failed to destroy in the first part of the task. Complete this and you reach the final battle with Zaxxon, the game looping with increased difficulty if you can survive the first time. There are three distinct skill levels, while controls involve using forward to dive and back to climb, in the manner

152476.overview: Zombie Apocalypse II is a mouse controlled shoot-em-up where the goal is to kill as many zombies possible before they reach the screen edge and zombie assistants before they perform the shot. At every level the player has to kill a certain number of zombies. The left mouse button is used for pistol fire and the right one for throwing the grenades. Ammo and grenades are limited, extra supplies are falling from the sky from time to time and are collected by shooting them down.

172411.overview:
In the distant future of the 30th century, the Earth is under attack by evil aliens, known as the Geeks. Their attempts at conquest have thus far proven unsuccessful due to humanity's advanced technology. But that might soon change: the Geeks have captured experimental time travel technology aboard an Earth defence satellite. Their plan is to travel into the past, disrupting the development of human technology, making conquest easy in the future. Our last hope is a lone soldier sent after the aliens. He must save Earth's scientists and destroy the Geeks in different time zones.

Zone Warrior is a side-scrolling platform game with exploration and shooting elements. It consists of five levels: Prehistoric, Egyptian, Medieval, Japanese and Future zones. Various enemies stand in the way, fitting the respective time period: dinosaurs and cavemen in prehistoric times, pharaohs in Egypt, robots in the future. The player's blaster can be upgraded to three- and five-way shots by collecting power-ups. Also available are various bombs and mines and a flamethrower. Levels are large and consists of distinct sections interconnected by doors and gates. To help navigating them, parts of a level map can be found. To complete a level, a number of hostages must be rescued and the Geek Commander destroyed. The Commander is located behind a security door, and a key must be found to open it. Also in each level is an armoury with some especially powerful weapons useful in defeating the Commander.

209068.overview:
Our hero Squinty has been trapped by his arch ­nemesis Odak. On his way to freedom, Squinty will find himself in Odak’s laboratory complex, on the surface, and in clammy dungeons. He will not only have to collect all gems in every corner, but also avoid falling into the ocean, getting eaten by piranhas, disappearing into the void, getting stung by poisonous spiders, and burning himself with hot lava.

However, there is one special catch: Odak has used his latest invention, the »Dimensional Transformer« on Squinty—now, everything around him appears distorted and looks vertically stretched. Only if Squinty squints real hard, he can see the world around him normally for a short period of time.

211244.overview: A very well done defender clone, shoot the aliens, save the humans when things get crazy use the smart bombs.

211245.overview:
After a series of events at the advanced polar base you look outside the base. Temperatures are very low and you have to get in, but there are creatures everywhere. The fire has spread and as it is chemical fire does not go out with the cold. Finds from a note reveals that the digs to enter the base are hidden by the auxiliary buildings. Stay on them, destroy the creatures and get those digs to get in.

Once inside you realize that all your companions are infected and decide to destroy all the creatures and the most important thing, burn and take the blood samples so that no one can experience this plague.

There are several types of weapons at the base, pilots, revolvers and flamethrowers, plan well your strategy to use the flamethrower, it is the best weapon and allow you to live longer. Watch out for the chemical fire and flammable boxes, a blow, a shot or a flame can make them burn and that will do your job more difficult.

Don't trust yourself, these creatures hide in any corner and can attack when you least expect it...

211246.overview: Released with issue 3 of the German magazine Amiga Fun, this flyabout multi-directional shooter lets you take your airship\zeppelin through the enemy controlled cave system. Bombing will help you get in, but only your wits can keep you alive! Gravity is constantly pulling you down, so get to the next refueling station if you want to keep this baby in the air.

211413.overview: A racing\reaction & navigation game where you fly your ship and avoid the blocking walls to get to the end of the track in the fastest possible time.

211657.overview: The Golden Medallion is an adventure game. The story begins when sorcerer Yenkin's feelings for the princess Perl have been rejected by her father. As a revenge, he decided to kidnap the object of his love. Taking the role of Dobromir the player must reach the land of Owlmountains and find the Golden Medallion. The game is divided into several locations with different puzzles. A task's solution open the access to the next area. The game features land, underwater and air stages.

211715.overview: Zdzisław: Bohater Galaktyki is a sci-fi action adventure game with vector graphics. On the 4th of July an alien spacecraft stunned Zdzisław and kidnapped his girlfriend. In order to save her the player must fly through the galaxy, find and use useful items in proper places and sometimes prove his agility skills. The spacecraft has a limited number of fuel, replenished only on the Earth. Maneuvering off and landing requires great caution, too rapid flight may cause ship explosion - one of many ways of death. Death in the game means necessity to start all over again. Each planet is divided into a few single location with at least one occasion to die and one item to acquire.

211717.overview: A type of Tetris inspired game where instead of different shapes you have to place sets of different hats and headware (kind of like Harris) two at a time.

211821.overview: Zaklęta Wyspa is a puzzle-solving game with elements of adventure story. The game begins with the kidnapping of Princess Andora by the evil sorcerer. Mendor unleashed an army of demons to conquer villages in the kingdom of Aldeoria. Now, each of thirty villages, is possessed by a demon. The daemon can be defeated only by solving a logical mini task. The game allows to select training and adventure mode. Training mode features all the thirty tasks with unlimited access. The adventure mode is played on the kingdom map, where the player moves from one village to another using the roads. Accessing new villages requires passing the trial in current village. Succeeded trial unlocks the road and allows to choose one of available direction. The puzzles are based on logic, chess, mathematics rules or a well known board games, such as master mind, domino or ships.

211868.overview:
The game was originally available as a game demo on the file site Aminet and is classed as a 3D Voxel space shooter in a first person view point, now updated with more content from the original creator Ralf Schmidt.

The game only supports AGA based Amigas.

211889.overview: ZGR3D is an Amiga adaption of the DOS game Kret for the Amiga. The aim of the player is to destroy Tetris-like blocks that fall down from the top of the screen. With each move the whole line of blocks drops down one line unless it cannot go further because the composition of the game field does not allow it. The player needs to move carefully through the field destroying the blocks without being squashed.

211909.overview:
An early Amiga PD Role Playing Game, created by Mike Shapiro. It is a Sword and Sorcery, topdown, Ultima style RPG. Released in 1989 for Amiga on Fish Disk 252; new version released in 1990. The title is as bare-bones as you can get, with basic inventory and basic character development. Its primary virtue is brevity plus a certain wit. It is also a rare Ultima clone for the Amiga. (It displays a roughly-Ultima II technology level, minus the dungeons, with a quest system that goes back to Akalabeth.) 
 
The game takes place in the land of Zerg, which is having problems with monsters. Each player controls the same character, named "Wanderer," who starts out as a Level 1 fighter with 75 strength, 75 wisdom, 75 agility, and 50 hit points. The game begins next to a king's castle, where the king is looking for a hero to slay monsters and bring back their cadavers. The king will use these trophies "to help investors feel more secure."

211910.overview: Great logical puzzler with awesome soundtrack (both in game and ending tune), created by Alive Designs and published in 1992. Recreate the picture in the top left corner in the game following the rules of piece movement on the level.

211912.overview:
Zerberk is a clone of the Stern arcade classic "Berzerk" for the Commodore Amiga. It was developed by Mathias Bock (aka Starfox) and released into the public domain in 1993. The game places you in a top-down maze environment, where your object is to kill all the robots on each level before you progress to the edge of the screen to begin the next level

The walls are electrified and will kill you on touch, Robots can also kill you if touched, or they shoot at you

There is a time limit on each level, when it is reached, Evil Otto appears, a smiley face character, who will follow you around the map, including through walls, until you either die, or get to the next level

You advance by clearing off all the Robots, and moving to one of the exits of the maze on screen, which will then increase the level number, and you then repeat, by clearing all the Robots and again advancing

There are Question Marks (?) which will randomly spawn, These can be fired at to give various special effects

The colours of the Enemy Robots and Screen change on each new level or lost life, You can only fire 1 laser at a time, and cannot fire another until it hits either the edge of the screen or a robot, so timing of shots is a must

212118.overview:
This is a nice shoot 'em up which has been programmed by the scener group Fanatix in 1992. The composers have done very good work. The game is set in the year 2176 on a long range colony called Zalycon, with a moonbase on a nearby moon, which is shortly thereafter attacked by aliens. You are the closest ship with a hyperspace angine, no one else will get there in time. The fate of the colony is in your hands.  
 
The first stage of the game is an avoid it type game, where you avoid the meteor shower to get there in time. Level 2 is moon buggy style mayhem to get to the armory. There is a puzzle required for access. Then you have a maze of Wolfenstein-like corridors to go through, when you find the aliens in it, the game becomes a cross-hairs shooter. If you survive, you find your way to the lab. There you confront the alien boss.

212235.overview: Alien Breed style game with a horror theme. You've been invited to a rave in an old mansion, but decide to join the fun. When you get there you find yourself trapped and the place is full of zombies, luckily you came prepared. The doors and windows are locked. You'll need to blast your way to the roof.

212510.overview: It's been a year since you got all the power crystals from the doomed star station Zyrad. All seemed quiet, but now, the Ena are back. This time they have attacked the Z2 superstation. It is all up to you again. A snake game, gather up the power crystals.

212511.overview: A strategy war game by Dave King written in AMOS and released in 1997.

213437.overview: An action game where you can set the color of the ball by hitting the palette on the left, once the ball color is set you can remove blocks of the same color, unfortunately you will die if you hit a skull and crossbones of the same color. Avoid the same color crossbones and remove all the blocks to move to the next level. Just to make things more interesting, there's a time limit!

213592.overview: A gambling five-card poker style game gambling created by Digital Marketing and released in Amiga Fun in 1990.

213593.overview:
ZNYK is, according to its documentation, yet another Tetris lookalike, but could just as well be based on Puyo Puyo, Pick 'n Pile or Columns.

From above, pairs of coloured balls come falling. The pairs can be swapped and rotated so as to match those balls already on the bottom of the screen. By making horizontal or vertical groups of four balls of the same colour, those groups are eliminated. The goal of each screen is to eliminate those balls present at the beginning of the stage, indicated by a white outline. The game then progresses to the next screen.

ZNYK is written in a mix of C and assembler, supports joystick or keyboard control and has a colourful, slick presentation with music, but is still multitasking-friendly. The source is (was) available for a small fee.

214775.overview: A puzzler created in by Hungarian coders Laszlo Körber, gfx Edvard Juhász and music by Peter Tolnai in 1993 and released on several compilations including Hungary For Fun, Three for Hungary and as part of the Amiga Forever Game Pack I.

214969.overview: A Dutch farming simulator slash vehicle avoidance game created by Herman Harmers, Cor De Vries and Richard van de Veen, known collectively as Video Computer Commericials and relased in 1989.

214979.overview: A single player puzzle\shape matching game in the style of Puzznic.  Coding & graphics by Crazy/Zeus; levels by Sledge/Zeus. Music by Richard Holmes (Snake/Zeus). The original release of ZEUS: THE GAME contains a bug on level 32 involving a block that cannot be paired, which makes it impossible to proceed beyond this level to complete the game. Fortunately, a bugfixed version was released on EAB in 2017. Also released in the Spielekiste #617 PD compilation disk.

215052.overview: Zenek Saper is an adaptation of classic Minesweeper game for up to two players. The rules remain unchanged. The player needs to find all the mines as quickly as possible. Clicking on a field shows a number indicating how many mines are located in the fields nearest to it. One mistake results in a mine explosion and the end of the game. The game features three difficulty levels with 10, 15 and 20 mines on a 10x10 grid board. In two player mode each player makes a movement alternately. Winning is possible in two ways - through the discovery of the last mine or a deadly mistake made by the opponent.

215068.overview:
Gloom MOD for the Amiga created by Gareth Murfin aka Alpha aka Zombie Massacre "Gloom4". Both 2 player co-op mode and 2 player combat mode are also available. In each level, your objective is to find an exit before your 3 lives run out. In specific levels, you must defeat (or escape) enemy bosses. The zombies are back in a standalone game. Zombie Massacre uses the Gloom Deluxe engine to create a first person shooter in a horror setting.
Gloom’s engine can throw a lot of enemy sprites at the player, so hordes of zombies are appropriate adversaries.

215150.overview: The The ZSoft Collection is a public domain collection of games including Boing 95 and RockHardWilly.

215376.overview:
A strategy game that appears to be based on the movie, Dawn of Dead. It is a turn-based strategy game where you have to seal off the mall and kill off all of the zombies without losing any of your party members.
- Zombies in a mall
- Turn-based squad shooter
- laser squad style gameplay, more like Act of War (shareware)
- 2D top down view
- mouse controlled
- simplistic tile graphics
- can break into shops for supplies, i.e. ammo/guns
- can shoot out windows
- small footprint game, possibly only a single executable

215394.overview: A target with reticle, crosshairs 2D shooter using Amiga's enhanced HAM mode graphics. Gameplay is in the style of Operation Wolf with first person horizontally scrolling action created by Tomasz Rogacewicz (STO) and Rolpho (D6) of Deck Six and released as freeware in 1997.

215673.overview: Zgadula is a Polish language game loosely based on the popular American TV game show, Wheel of Fortune for the Commodore Amiga. The players take turns guessing the consonants or buying the vowels to form a word or a saying. The game allows up to three human or computer players for on up to nine rounds. Each turn begins with the wheel spin, determining a win prize for the consonant or ending up with bankruptcy or loss of the turn. After the last round, a winner is the player with the largest amount of money.

217044.overview:
Zork Trilogy is a compilation of all three of Infocom's original Zork games:

    Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
    Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
    Zork III: The Dungeon Master 

The package also includes an item that was featured as an in-game object in Zork games: the Zorkmid Coin.

217073.overview: A vertical shooting game for one or two players including cooperative play, created by Jürgen Malzacher\Juergen Malzacher and Stephan Brack and released in 1989, the game has no end. Game is included on Amiga Software Extra Issue 12, Disk 2.

217074.overview:
This was a free game released by Activision to celebrate and promote their newest game, at the time, Zork: Grand Inquisitor. It is a text only adventure done in the style on the original Zork games.

The year in 1066. You're a private, 7th class, in the Inquisition Guard. After getting relieved of your post at the Port Foozle Inquisition Gift Kiosk, you see the Pastor of Disaster, the Minister of Sinister, the Grand Inquisitor. It looks like he has a job for you. Yes, you. After asking about other, ANY other, guards to go instead, you have your orders. Sigh. Very well. Archaeologists have unearthed a tunnel that seems to lead to a new section of the Great Underground Empire or GUE. You are to enter this tunnel and explore the Great Underground Empire. You'll be back in no time. You hope. 
 
This Amiga version was made using the Amiga Frotz interpreter.

217253.overview:
My entry for Blitzbasic Game Jam 2022.
A top down racer, with only 4 tracks.
Practice is advised before entering the race.
Avoid collision with the background and other cars
You can disable collisions with cpu cars,  it will be easier.

217539.overview:
ZapTris - Version 1.26 - Shareware (Amiga)
Exellent tetris-clone! - Much of special
things - Also normal Tetris-mode - Very
flexible (much of settings) - 80 levels -
Link- and demogames - You can play your own
background-musics - Three Top 10-lists &
much more

418270.overview: A single player German language point and click adventure game created by Andreas Suter and Phillipp and Claude Gressly and released as freeware in 1994.

420968.overview: Zyrad is a shareware game by Steven Scougal that is similar to that of the Worms/Snake type game. Basically you have to collect objects whilst avoiding your ever growing tail. This game has a sequel, Zyrad 2.

420972.overview: An unfinished strategy wargame from Robin Siegemund from 1996.

421061.overview:
A freewae horizontally scrolling shooter created by Dimmen Produkties in 1988. This shooter is different because just like in reality, you only have one life so you had better guard it well. It was released in both International Arcade Action and the Amiga Stars Collection.  
 
Fast and furious arcade action. Dare you enter into space, if you do there are waves of aliens, doing everything in their power to stop you. For those with fast reaction and shoot-em up skills.... take the challenge.

422371.overview: A PD game by Kelvin Truswell, made in 1993. The goal for one player is to keep his marble on the board and for the other to use the many marbles to knock the other one off. There are stun, power punch and other items that give you more charge or punch when you collide.

422548.overview:
Zut Alors II is the second shareware, text-only adventure in which you play the part of Cyrano de Bergerbar, a young blade who has recently arrived in Paris with a burning ambition to join the King's Musketeers like his idols Athos, Porthos, Aramis and D'Artagnan. This he has now achieved, and the second adventure takes up a few months after the first ended. Cyrano has now found better lodgings near the Musketeers' HQ and has acquired a dim but loyal servant named LePlank. The only black cloud on his otherwise bright horizon is the fact that his girlfriend Constance has left him.

Beyond that, the actual plot of the game will become clear as you play it...

422592.overview:
A shareware adventure game from Brian Asbury, originally a Quilled adventure for ZX Spectrum, inspired by Games Workshop's En Guarde. The later Amiga version was written using Hatrack II and dates from 1991. The Amiga version was included on the Amiga Computing issue 43 (December 1991) coverdisk. Version 2.3 (from August 1994) fixes several serious bugs, such as issues with the drop/remove and save/load routines, as well as adds extra features. 
 
Zut Alors! is a text-only adventure in which you play the part of Cyrano de Bergerbar, a young blade recently arrived in Paris to seek his fortune. Cyrano has a burning ambition to join the King's Musketeers like his idols Athos, Porthos, Aramis and D'Artagnan, and, indeed, this is the object of the game. To win, you have to become a Musketeer. This is not as easy as it sounds, as you must firstly prove yourself in the ranks of lesser regiments.

422606.overview: A Polish-language, educational game focused on adding integers, subtracting, whole numbers, multiplying whole numbers. First released by Mikrozet in 1991, there were re-released at least twice more.

422869.overview:
Zdrajca is a black and white adventure game with digitized speech and video sequences. One day a holder of the Amiga learns about the new Playstation console. He decided to sell his computer to buy a dream gaming hardware. On the day of sale computer has been damaged and needs to be repaired within designated time.

The game screen is divided into action menu, inventory, destination places (with map as alternative travel possibility), conversation panel and picture/video box. Conversation allows to choose one of three available sentences, resulting in displaying the appropriate video sequences. The main task requires finding appropriate objects, performing mini-quest and connecting suitable objects.

423356.overview:
Rolling demo for a game where a pilot is warned by a mysterious stranger that something terrible is about to happen in his town. Rushing home, the pilot discovers that his wife and baby daughter were murdered. The stranger who tried to warn the pilot is gravely wounded; however, before dying, he passes some information to him. The hero is back on his plane, determined to avenge the deaths of his beloved ones, alone against terrorist forces whose true goals are yet unknown...

Zone 66 is a top-down shooter in which the player controls an aircraft, eliminating other planes as well as ground-based hostile units (tanks, etc.). The player-controlled aircraft is able to move in any direction, avoiding enemy fire or preparing a better angle for the next shot. There is a wide selection of aircraft to choose from and each of them, before the gameplay, can be individually equipped with different types of weapons like missiles and bombs.

423362.overview: A Zelda type RPG playable demo according to the author, Anthony Sherratt of ASP Software in 1996.

423454.overview: The first level of a rather unconventional text adventure from the near future, where it is not acceptable to be heterosexual. Created by Crudesys and released as freeware in 2008.

423754.overview: A Czech language AMOS based intelligence test created by Striped Dog and released as freeware in 1994.

423796.overview: Zabawa: Grajek & Malarz is a commercial Polish title created by Jacek Korotkiewicz that allows children to develop painting and musical skills. There are two different modes available: painting and musical keyboard. The first one consists of simple painting features, the second one allows to play simple melodies.

424018.overview: Zombie is a platform game. Trapped inside the pyramid, Czaka must find the way out. The task requires locating all the passes to the closed gates and a battery to activate the teleporter to the next level. The mission is complicated by the different mechanisms and creatures inhabiting pyramid. Contact with them means a loss of energy, which may be supplemented thanks to special flasks and life adding hearts.

450599.overview: Zorgons Revenge is an Amiga homebrew conversion of the 1983 Oric-1/Atomos game of the same name. The Amiga conversion was developed by Philippe Guichardon and released into the public domain in 2016.
